All logic lives in `worker/src/services/ai-dm.ts`:

- **`askDM()`** calls primary model **`@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`**; on error/exception, catches it and retries with fallback model **`@cf/mistral/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2-lora`**. If that also throws, it returns **`fallbackNarrative(playerAction)`** directly.
- **`parseAIResponse(raw, playerAction)`** handles bad/non-JSON text: guards empty/non-string input, strips markdown fences, regex-extracts a `{...}` block if the text doesn't start with `{`, then `JSON.parse`s it inside a `try/catch` — any failure (missing JSON, parse error) returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)`. Parsed fields are also individually null/array-guarded with `??`/`Array.isArray` defaults (e.g. `suggestedActions` defaults to `['Look around', 'Search the area', 'Listen carefully', 'Move on']`).
- **`fallbackNarrative(playerAction)`** returns a hardcoded generic `AIDMResponse`: a vague narrative ("You attempt to ... The world shifts around you...") with all `gameStateChanges` null/false/empty, default `suggestedActions` (`'Look around', 'Proceed carefully', 'Listen for sounds', 'Rest a moment'`), and empty `diceRolls`.

Similar patterns (try/catch + hardcoded fallback) exist in `generateQuest`, `generateBackstory`, and `generateLevelUpNarrative`, each also using `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast` and returning fixed fallback text/values on failure.
